line: Crowley's Five of Wands is the card for the first decan of Leo, with Saturn as its planet in the sign.

sections.title: Crowley's card for this decan
sections.line: The text names the pair Saturn and Leo; the attribution table reads Saturn in Leo.

quotes.quote: the five of Wands is called Strife.
It is ruled also by Saturn and Leo.

sections.title: What the card is, in his words
sections.line: His description of what the card figures, as the card chapter gives it.

quotes.quote: There is no limit to the scope of this volcanic energy.
